definitions: A financing round that occurs between two larger, more significant funding rounds, typically to provide a company with enough capital to reach its next major milestone or secure its next larger funding round.
Interim funding to sustain operations until a more substantial investment can be secured.
examples: The startup secured a bridge round to extend its runway until the Series A.
They needed a bridge round to cover expenses while developing their new product.
Investors participated in a bridge round to help the company reach profitability.
